name: Storm-2945 (CaptiveCrunch)
akas: Midnight Blizzard / APT29 / Cozy Bear / NOBELIUM / The Dukes (sub-cluster)
brief: Microsoft Threat Intelligence disclosed "CaptiveCrunch," a Midnight Blizzard sub-cluster campaign manipulating hotel/conference-venue Wi-Fi captive-portal DNS/HTTP traffic to redirect corporate travelers to phishing pages since early May 2026, and running AI-augmented device-code and OAuth-code phishing against Microsoft Entra ID since February 2026. Microsoft states it "observed Storm-2945 leveraging AI to support a significant portion of these operations." Deployed malware includes CornFlake (Golang Windows RAT), ChocoShell (a PowerShell infostealer whose "consistent coding standard and descriptive commentary suggest the author might have leveraged AI-assisted code generation"), and the FruitStone web C2 panel; the actor also abused a Chrome App-Bound Encryption bypass for session-token theft. Microsoft
ttpMd:
**LLM-supported social engineering** T1566 - Phishing (AI-augmented device-code & OAuth phishing campaigns)

**LLM-aided development** T1587.001 - Develop Capabilities: Malware (ChocoShell infostealer; AI-assisted code generation inferred from code style)

T1528 - Steal Application Access Token (device-code/OAuth phishing against Entra ID)
